# The motif fixture table is generated by chemcomp-tblgen rather than
# mlir-tblgen: it emits a plain data table, not MLIR IR constructs.
#
# mlir_tablegen() hardcodes ${MLIR_TABLEGEN_EXE}, so drive the custom command
# directly. The output lands in the build tree's include dir, which the
# top-level CMakeLists already puts on the include path.
set(LLVM_TARGET_DEFINITIONS MotifsFixture.td)

set(_motif_inc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/MotifsFixture.inc)

add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT ${_motif_inc}
  COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:chemcomp-tblgen> -gen-motif-db
          -I ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
          -I ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
          ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/MotifsFixture.td
          -o ${_motif_inc}
  DEPENDS chemcomp-tblgen
          ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/MotifsFixture.td
          ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/MotifBase.td
  COMMENT "Building MotifsFixture.inc..."
)

add_custom_target(ChemCompMotifsIncGen DEPENDS ${_motif_inc})
set_target_properties(ChemCompMotifsIncGen PROPERTIES FOLDER "Tablegenning")
